items.label: Install the complete Windows PC route

levels.1: Check the downloaded-content selector before beginning.
levels.2: Install the base game and every campaign, equipment, skin, and character addition included with the Season Pass.
levels.3: Use the Windows PC Digital Deluxe entitlement or base game plus Season Pass. Confirm every added campaign map, weapon pack, character pack, and rifle-skin set appears in its respective selector before recording completion.

items.label: Complete every base mission on Authentic Plus

levels.1: Learn each map first, then return with a dependable route and loadout.
levels.2: Finish every base campaign map with Authentic Plus selected.
levels.3: Choose the built-in Authentic Plus preset, not a custom approximation. Assistance is minimized, enemies are least forgiving, and manual saving is restricted; finish each base map and verify its difficulty emblem in Mission Select.

items.label: Complete every base mission on Authentic Plus without manual saves

levels.1: Treat each map as one deliberate run and rehearse extraction before committing.
levels.2: Finish every base map on Authentic Plus without creating a manual save during any run.
levels.3: Start each map directly on Authentic Plus, never use Save Game, and complete it in the same run. Automatic checkpoints are permitted by the game record; verify the separate no-manual-save completion marker after every map before continuing.

levels.1: Optional objectives, varied eliminations, and co-op sessions keep experience flowing.
levels.2: Accumulate campaign and online experience until the Service Record shows rank 50.
levels.3: Finish mission objectives and challenges rather than farming only basic eliminations. At ranks 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, and 30 choose a skill, then continue to rank 50 and confirm every rank-gated loadout or character reward is available.

items.label: Try both choices at every skill tier

levels.1: Each rank milestone opens a pair; learn how both options affect a loadout.
levels.2: At ranks 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, and 30, select each side of that tier at least once between missions.
levels.3: Only one skill from each pair can be active at a time, but the choice is not permanent. In the pre-mission skill screen, switch every tier to its opposite option, start a mission so the selection takes effect, then restore the six choices you prefer.

items.label: Use Mission Select for permanent cleanup

levels.1: Nothing in the base campaign needs a second save file.
levels.2: Reopen completed maps for collectibles, objectives, challenges, and higher-difficulty records.
levels.3: Collectible registration is immediate, but mission challenges, optional objectives, and difficulty records should be checked after completion. Use Mission Select and the Service Record as the authoritative cleanup screens; there is no separate New Game Plus campaign.

areas.name: Records, Secrets, and Cooperative Cleanup
areas.location_cue: The Shooting Range, cooperative campaign selector, and Service Record statistic pages.
areas.note: These rows capture persistent systems, reward-bearing records, and the reproducible hidden location not represented by the map collectible counter.

levels.1: Vary play styles and inspect the Service Record for incomplete categories.
levels.2: Complete every target exercise with every installed weapon class.
levels.3: Run each fixed and moving target lane, then test every installed rifle, secondary, and pistol until all range records and prompts are complete.

levels.1: Vary play styles and inspect the Service Record for incomplete categories.
levels.2: Record at least one elimination with every usable firearm.
levels.3: Use every loadout weapon plus mission pickups such as the Panzerfaust. Check Service Record after each class; environmental emplacements do not replace a handheld weapon entry.

levels.1: Vary play styles and inspect the Service Record for incomplete categories.
levels.2: Register every distinct organ-shot category.
levels.3: Use rifle precision and the post-shot record to fill each organ category. Vary frontal, side, and rear angles until no anatomical entry remains absent.

levels.1: Vary play styles and inspect the Service Record for incomplete categories.
levels.2: Identify and neutralize every infantry archetype.
levels.3: Use binocular Target Focus on ordinary troops, officers, radio operators, snipers, spotters, Jägers, support troops, and launcher specialists, then confirm all profile categories in Service Record.

levels.1: Vary play styles and inspect the Service Record for incomplete categories.
levels.2: Fully analyze one hundred targets.
levels.3: Hold binocular focus on tagged enemies until the full information panel completes; repeat on one hundred distinct targets and verify the cumulative counter.

levels.1: Vary play styles and inspect the Service Record for incomplete categories.
levels.2: Accumulate one hundred kilometres of confirmed elimination distance.
levels.3: Prefer long open sightlines during campaign, Survival, and Distance King. The Service Record adds confirmed shot distance across sessions; continue until it passes 100 km.

levels.1: Vary play styles and inspect the Service Record for incomplete categories.
levels.2: Record one hundred trap eliminations.
levels.3: Rotate trip mines, S-mines, Teller mines, and booby-trapped bodies. Confirm each elimination is credited as a trap in Service Record rather than a direct explosive shot.

levels.1: Vary play styles and inspect the Service Record for incomplete categories.
levels.2: Destroy twenty-five occupied vehicles or fortified emplacements with satchel charges.
levels.3: Approach a crewed vehicle, pillbox, or turret position, place the prompted satchel charge, move outside the blast radius, and repeat until the Service Record counter reaches twenty-five.

levels.1: Vary play styles and inspect the Service Record for incomplete categories.
levels.2: Defeat five enemies with one artillery strike.
levels.3: Tag a dense patrol near an artillery-call opportunity, wait for them to bunch inside the strike circle, then trigger the barrage and confirm five eliminations from that single call.

levels.1: Vary play styles and inspect the Service Record for incomplete categories.
levels.2: Use three different types of falling environmental hazard.
levels.3: Inspect suspended cargo, cranes, rock or log supports, and chandeliers. Trigger three distinct hazard designs while an enemy is beneath each; repeating one prop type does not fill the variety record.

levels.1: Vary play styles and inspect the Service Record for incomplete categories.
levels.2: Follow the concealed Magazzeno trail from the upper naval-gun district to its hidden room and cave.
levels.3: At Magazzeno, inspect the upper naval-gun area on the pause map's left side and read the nearby papers. Then check the foliage-covered masonry beside the code-breaking room, pass through the concealed opening, and examine both the historical photograph and the supply cave.

levels.1: Vary play styles and inspect the Service Record for incomplete categories.
levels.2: Complete every installed campaign mission cooperatively.
levels.3: Host or join each base and downloaded mission, remain together through extraction, and verify both profiles receive completion. Repeat any map whose cooperative emblem is missing.

levels.1: Vary play styles and inspect the Service Record for incomplete categories.
levels.2: Eliminate five snipers before any of them spots you.
levels.3: Tag distant glints from cover, approach outside their view cones, and finish five snipers before their awareness reaches confirmed detection. The counter is cumulative, so a later sniper may continue the record.

levels.1: Vary play styles and inspect the Service Record for incomplete categories.
levels.2: Record one hundred eliminations with suppressed ammunition.
levels.3: Equip suppressed rifle or pistol ammunition before deployment and reserve it for clean shots. Continue across missions until the Service Record reaches one hundred; sound masking without suppressed ammunition does not replace the ammunition requirement.

levels.1: Vary play styles and inspect the Service Record for incomplete categories.
levels.2: Finish one solo mission while consuming neither type of healing item.
levels.3: Choose a familiar mission, avoid both the medikit and bandage prompts for the full visit, and reach extraction. Automatic health recovery does not consume an item, but either inventory heal invalidates the run.

levels.1: Vary play styles and inspect the Service Record for incomplete categories.
levels.2: Record one hundred pistol eliminations.
levels.3: Use any pistol across campaign, Survival, or compatible online play and verify the cumulative pistol counter reaches one hundred. Incapacitations only count after the pistol supplies the final elimination.

levels.1: Vary play styles and inspect the Service Record for incomplete categories.
levels.2: Record two hundred fifty secondary-weapon eliminations.
levels.3: Rotate submachine guns and shotguns while completing other tasks, and check that the Service Record classifies each final blow as Secondary. Continue until the class counter reaches 250.

levels.1: Vary play styles and inspect the Service Record for incomplete categories.
levels.2: Record five hundred rifle eliminations.
levels.3: Use scoped and iron-sight rifle fire throughout campaign and Survival until the rifle total reaches five hundred. Environmental blasts triggered by a rifle shot may not credit the weapon, so verify the counter periodically.

levels.1: Vary play styles and inspect the Service Record for incomplete categories.
levels.2: Complete one base campaign mission using rifle eliminations only.
levels.3: Choose a familiar base map and use the rifle for every required elimination. Avoid melee, pistol, secondary, traps, environmental hazards, and damaging explosives, then finish the mission so the restriction is recorded.

levels.1: Vary play styles and inspect the Service Record for incomplete categories.
levels.2: Incapacitate an enemy, then finish with a testicle shot.
levels.3: Use a nonlethal limb hit or another reliable incapacitation, approach from a clear frontal angle, and place the follow-up shot at the pelvis. Wait for the specialized notification before leaving.

levels.1: Vary play styles and inspect the Service Record for incomplete categories.
levels.2: Destroy the departing plane with a bolt-action rifle.
levels.3: Bring a bolt-action rifle to the final base map, allow the plane to take off, and wait for its returning approach. Shoot the exposed missile or disable both engines with that rifle; another weapon class does not record this method.
